chunks: And in the narration of Wahb ibn Wahb al-Qurashi, from al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, from his forefathers, from Ali, peace be upon him, who said:
"There is no zakat on the wealth of the mukatab."

key_terms.آبَائِهِ: his forefathers in the chain of transmission
key_terms.الْمُكَاتَبِ: a slave under a contractual agreement for emancipation
key_terms.زَكَاةٌ: the obligatory alms-tax due on qualifying wealth

ai.seo_question: Is zakat obligatory on the wealth of a mukatab?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling that zakat is not due on the wealth of a mukatab, a slave under a manumission contract. It relates to the jurisprudence of zakat and the financial status of persons with restricted ownership.
